summary_en: This study is testing AZD8205, a new antibody drug conjugate, alone or combined with other anticancer agents in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors, including breast, biliary tract, ovarian, endometrial, and squamous non-small cell lung cancer. The route, dose, and schedule are not stated in the record. The main outcomes are safety, tolerability, and the recommended Phase 2 dose or maximum tolerated dose in dose escalation, and anti-tumor activity in dose expansion.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa AZD8205, un nuevo conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, solo o combinado con otros agentes anticancerosos, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos, incluidos cáncer de mama, carcinoma de vías biliares, cáncer de ovario, cáncer de endometrio y cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas de tipo escamoso. La vía de administración, la dosis y el esquema no se indican en el registro. Los resultados principales son la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la dosis recomendada de fase 2 o la dosis máxima tolerada en la fase de escalada de dosis, y la actividad antitumoral en la fase de expansión.
who_for: Relapsed or metastatic solid tumor treated with prior standard therapy, or where the investigator judges a trial is the best next option.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and life expectancy of 12 weeks or more.
Histologically or cytologically confirmed breast, ovarian, biliary tract, endometrial, or squamous non-small cell lung cancer (sub-study criteria vary).
not_for: Nitrosourea or mitomycin C within 6 weeks before first dose.
Spinal cord compression or history of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
Active infection, including tuberculosis, HBV, HCV, or HIV.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed steroids.
Symptomatic heart failure (NYHA class 2 or higher) or history of MDS or AML.
